message.content:
**Your Ultimate “Paris on Foot” Trip Plan (10 Days)**  
*(Feel free to shorten or lengthen each segment – this is a flexible framework.)*

---

### ✈️ Pre‑Trip Checklist  

| Item | Why It Matters |
|------|----------------|
| **Passport & Visa** | Check expiry >6 months ahead. EU/US citizens usually don’t need visas for stays <90 days. |
| **Travel Insurance** | Covers medical emergencies + lost luggage. |
| **Flight Booking** | Book early (~2–3 months) for cheapest fares. Look at airlines flying into Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly (ORY). |
| **Accommodation** | Reserve via Airbnb, Booking.com, or direct hotel sites. Aim for central arrondissements (1st–7th) for easy walking access. |
| **Transport Passes** | *Navigo Week Pass* (€22.80) covers metro, RER, buses within zones 1‑5. Great value if staying ≥7 nights. |
| **SIM Card / Roaming** | Buy a local SIM (Orange, SFR, Bouygues) ~€15 for data+calls. |
| **Packing List** | Comfortable shoes, light layers, umbrella, power adapter (Type C/E), reusable water bottle, small backpack. |

> **Tip:** Download offline maps (Google Maps → Settings → Offline map download) so you’re never stranded without Wi‑Fi.

---

## Day‑by‑Day Itinerary

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Arrive CDG → Take RER B to Saint‑Charles station (≈35 min). Walk to your lodging. | Grab a croissant from a nearby boulangerie. |
| **Mid‑morning** | Visit Notre‑Dame Cathedral & Île de la Cité | Free entry; climb to towers for city views. |
| **Lunch** | Café Lalo (12 Rue des Martyrs) | Try their quiche Lorraine. |
| **Afternoon** | Explore Latin Quarter: Panthéon, Sorbonne, Luxembourg Gardens | Stroll along Rue Mouffetard market stalls. |
| **Evening** | Seine River Cruise (Bateaux Mouches) | Sunset cruise gives iconic skyline view. |
| **Dinner** | Le Coupe Chou (11 Rue de l'Ancienne Comédie) | Classic French ambience. |

---

### Day 2 – Art & Culture

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Louvre Museum | Get skip‑the‑line ticket online. Focus on Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, Winged Victory. |
| Lunch | Inside museum café or bring picnic to Tuileries Garden. |
| Afternoon | Palais Royal & Jardin du Palais | Browse chic boutiques & art galleries. |
| Evening | Opera Garnier tour | Even if no show, guided walk inside is worth it. |
| Dinner | La Fontaine de Mars (near opera house) | Traditional bistro fare. |

---

### Day 3 – Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Climb up to Basilique du Sacré‑Cœur | Stunning panoramic shots. |
| Mid‑day | Place du Tertre artists’ square | Pick up a sketch or portrait. |
| Lunch | Le Consulat (historic café) | Sample escargot. |
| Afternoon | Musée d’Orsay | Impressionist masterpieces. |
| Night | Moulin Rouge show (optional) | Book in advance; consider dinner package. |

---

### Day 4 – Modern Architecture & Shopping

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Centre Pompidou | Contemporary art hub. |
| Lunch | Les Halles food court | Quick bites & street vendors. |
| Afternoon | Galeries Lafayette & Printemps | Window shop luxury brands; rooftop terrace offers great photo ops. |
| Evening | Eiffel Tower visit | Book “Top Deck” reservation for sunset viewing. |
| Dinner | 58 Tour Eiffel restaurant (if booked) or nearby rue Cler cafés. |

---

### Day 5 – Versailles Excursion

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Early morning | Train to Versailles Château (RER C) | Tickets €9.50 roundtrip. |
| Full day | Palace tours, Hall of Mirrors, Gardens, Grand Trianons | Consider audio guide. |
| Late afternoon | Return to Paris; relax at Parc Monceau. |
| Dinner | Bistro near your hotel. |

---

### Day 6 – Hidden Gems & Local Life

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Canal Saint-Martin stroll | Quaint bridges, vintage shops. |
| Lunch | Breizh Café (crêpes & cider). |
| Afternoon | Marché aux Puces de Saint-Ouen flea market | Hunt antiques & unique finds. |
| Evening | Jazz club at Duc des Lombards | Live music until midnight. |
| Dinner | Street food around Oberkampf district. |

---

### Day 7 – Food & Wine Immersion

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Breakfast | Brunch at Holybelly (Le Marais). |
| Morning | Cheese tasting workshop (Fromagerie Barthélémy). |
| Lunch | Picnic in Champ de Mars with baguette, cheese, wine. |
| Afternoon | Champagne cellars in Reims (via train) | Optional half‑day excursion. |
| Evening | Back to Paris; dessert at Ladurée Champs‑Élysées. |
| Dinner | Michelin‑starred experience (e.g., Septime) – book weeks ahead. |

---

### Day 8 – Parks & Relaxation

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Bois de Boulogne | Rent bikes or paddle boats. |
| Lunch | Picnicking under trees. |
| Afternoon | Fondation Louis Vuitton | Contemporary architecture & exhibitions. |
| Evening | Light show at Pont Alexandre III | Beautiful nighttime illumination. |
| Dinner | Casual brasserie near your stay. |

---

### Day 9 – Cultural Deep Dive

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Sainte-Chapelle | Gothic stained glass masterpiece. |
| Lunch | Nearby café in Île Saint-Louis. |
| Afternoon | Picasso Museum or Rodin Museum | Choose based on preference. |
| Evening | Attend a ballet or theater performance at Théâtre Mogador. |
| Dinner | Fine-dining at Le Jules Verne (Eiffel Tower) – last chance! |

---

### Day 10 – Departure Prep & Souvenir Hunting

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Morning | Pack & check out. Store bags at hotel concierge. |
| Mid‑morning | Last‑minute shopping at Rue de Rivoli or concept stores like Colette’s successor. |
| Lunch | Farewell lunch at Angelina (famous hot chocolate). |
| Afternoon | Retrieve bags → Head to airport via RER B or taxi. |
| Flight | Depart homeward bound. |

---

## Budget Snapshot (per person)

| Category | Approx Cost (€) |
|----------|------------------|
| Flights | 350–700 (depending season & origin) |
| Accommodation (mid‑range hotels/Airbnb) | 1200–1800 |
| Transport pass (Navi­go week) | 23 |
| Attractions (skip‑lines, museums) | 200 |
| Dining (mix of casual & fine) | 600 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, extra transport) | 150 |
| **Total** | **~2800–3600** |

> Adjust numbers upward/downward depending on luxury vs economy choices.

---

## Insider Tips

1. **Avoid Peak Hours** – Museums open at 9 am; arrive right when doors open to beat crowds.  
2. **Use Metro Over Taxi** – Faster during rush hours; cheaper overall.  
3. **Reserve Restaurants Online** – Especially for high-end spots; many require booking 30–60 days prior.  
4. **Try “Happy Hour” Bars** – Many bars offer discounted drinks after 6 pm.  
5. **Stay Hydrated** – Carry a refillable bottle; tap water is safe.  
6. **Learn Basic Phrases** – Bonjour, Merci, Où est… will earn smiles.  
7. **Check Weather Forecast** – Paris weather can shift quickly; pack an umbrella.  
8. **Explore Off‑Peak Days** – Visiting major sights mid‑week reduces wait times.  

---

Enjoy your adventure through the City of Lights! If you'd like more specific recommendations—like boutique hotels, secret speakeasies, or family-friendly itineraries—just let me know. Bon voyage!
